observations: Photo 0: Black Xbox One X console with a black controller on top, placed on a blue glass table. The console has a visible 'X' logo on the front right. The background shows a blue glass cabinet with laptops inside, and a sign that says 'HILIFE STORES LTD'.

Photo 1: Same console and controller, but from a slightly different angle. The front panel shows multiple ports, including HDMI and USB. A small white label is visible on the front right, but the text is not legible. The background is the same as photo 0.

Photo 2: Top-down view of the console with the controller on top. The 'X' logo is visible on the top surface. The console appears to have some scuffs and wear, especially on the top surface. The background shows the same store environment.
All photos have a watermark: 'POSTED ON JIJI HILIFE STORES LTD'.

identity.kind: Xbox One X console with one controller

claims.claim: Uk used Microsoft Xbox One X 1TB storage
claims.evidence: The console is identifiable as an Xbox One X from the 'X' logo and design, but the storage capacity (1TB) is not visible in any photo. The seller's claim cannot be confirmed from the images.
One black controller is visible on top of the console in all three photos.
No games are visible in any photo. The claim cannot be verified remotely.
The background in all photos shows a store environment with glass cabinets and a sign that says 'HILIFE STORES LTD'.
Subjective claim; cannot be verified from photos.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Console may not be 1TB storage as claimed
risks.proof: Photo of the console's label or screen showing storage capacity, or a video of the console booting and showing storage info.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if it is not 1TB, which may be a significant discount.

risks.risk: Console may be damaged or non-functional
risks.proof: Video of the console powering on, booting up, and showing the dashboard or menu.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, which is a major discount.

risks.risk: Controller may be non-functional or missing accessories
risks.proof: Video of the controller connecting to the console and responding to inputs.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if the controller is not working or missing, which reduces value.

risks.risk: Console may have internal damage or hardware issues
risks.proof: Photo or video of the console's internal components or a diagnostic test report.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if it has hidden damage, which reduces value.

proof_requests: Photo of the console's label or screen showing the model and storage capacity.
Video of the console powering on and booting up.
Video of the controller connecting and working with the console.
Photo or video of the console's internal components or a diagnostic test report.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
